defects.description: ListLinkedRepos, in unchanged sibling code, still JSON-encodes each repository's settings with the new webhook secret, while GetLinkedRepo and UpdateLinkedRepo were fixed to redact it.
AnswerPrompt adds the pull request description, which any author can write, to the privileged project-context prompt, while untrusted comments are filtered out.
The Starter plan gate refuses an update to the current status (implementing to implementing), which agents send when they resume, because it runs before the no-op check and uses <=.

EnsureSigningSecret reads the repository, sends a new secret to the provider, then writes the whole record back, so overlapping calls leave the provider and the store with different secrets and can overwrite concurrent settings changes.
CheckName returns the legacy check name from a repository-wide flag before reading the base branch's own protection rule, so a branch that requires the plain name is blocked forever.
Purging an expired session now cascades to the fingerprint-keyed dismissals that Suppress reads across every review, so purged history makes dismissed findings come back.
Parse treats a line inside a hunk that looks like a file header (an added line whose text starts with "++ ") as a new file header, so a crafted diff moves later added lines to another path.

decoys.description: redacted clears the secret on a value copy; the stored record keeps it.
Verify decodes the signature and compares HMAC-SHA256 values with hmac.Equal, rejecting an empty secret.
SecretField shows only whether a secret is set and a password input for a replacement.
